title: AI forgets the middle of your doc
hook: AI forgets the middle of your doc

beats.say: Paste a long document into an AI, and the middle might as well be invisible.
Researchers tested this by hiding one key fact at different spots in a long input.
Accuracy was best at the start and the end, and dropped in the middle.
They called it lost in the middle. Newer models are better at this, but the lesson still pays off.
Anthropic's own advice: put long documents at the top, and your question at the very end.
Same words, better answers, just by moving them.

caption: "Lost in the Middle" (Liu et al., 2023): models found a key fact best when it sat at the start or end of a long input, and worst in the middle. Newer models handle long inputs better, but Anthropic's prompting docs still recommend long documents at the top and your question at the end.
sources: Liu et al., 'Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts' (2023)
Anthropic docs: long context prompting tips (longform data at the top, query at the end)
Curve is illustrative of the U-shape, not exact numbers
